rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium apex is predominantly composed of pale/pink pixels (approximately 85%), with dark melanin pigmentation restricted to the peripheral margins and the central philtrum groove (approximately 15%).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous small, dark punctate spots are visible across the muzzle, maxillary region, and forehead, consistent with high fly density or minor superficial lesions; no major physical trauma or scars are clearly discernable at this resolution.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, high-contrast pigmentation is visible on the distal margins and posterior tips of both ears.
